data.one_liner: A simple and customizable animated button with 3D-like effect.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable button widget featuring built-in 3D-like animation effects when pressed. It supports adjustable dimensions, colors, border radius, shadow degrees, and enabled/disabled states.
use_when: You need a simple button with a 3D-like pressing animation.
You want a customizable button with built-in shadow and duration control.
avoid_when: You require complex state management solutions.
You need standard Material design buttons without custom 3D animations.
strengths: Easy to integrate and customize with various attributes.
Supports custom border radius and disabled colors.
weaknesses: Limited to a specific 3D-like button style.
Circle box shape was removed in recent versions.
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedButton(
  onPressed: () {},
  color: Colors.blue,
  shadowDegree: ShadowDegree.light,
  child: Text('Animated button', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
)
